tools.name: braille_convert
tools.description:
Converts text to WIA Braille, a pronunciation-based common braille (NOT an official national braille code). Returns IPA and braille cells (6-dot paper form or 8-dot canonical form), plus quality/confidence. Low-quality results are flagged, not hidden.
한국어: 텍스트를 발음 기반 WIA 점자로 변환합니다(국가 공식 점자 아님).

tools.name: braille_languages
tools.description:
Lists or searches the languages the WIA Braille engine can convert (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code.). Shows the conversion sources per language (rules, dictionary, espeak).
한국어: 지원 언어를 목록·검색합니다.

tools.name: braille_to_brf
tools.description:
Converts Unicode braille cells to BRF (NABCC 6-dot ASCII braille, the text format embossers read), with line/page wrapping (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code.). 8-dot cells are converted to 6-dot by the engine and reported.
한국어: 유니코드 점자를 엠보서용 BRF 텍스트로 변환합니다.

tools.name: braille_verify_brf
tools.description:
Runs 9 automatic checks on BRF text (mapping, line length, page length, CRLF, form feed, round trip, ...). Does not check paper quality or dot depth (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code.).
한국어: BRF 텍스트를 9개 항목으로 자동 검증합니다.

tools.name: braille_math_nemeth
tools.description:
Converts a linear math expression (e.g. x^2+1=5) to Nemeth-code braille cells. Note the surrounding engine is pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code. Best for linear expressions; complex 2D layouts need reviewer post-processing.
한국어: 한 줄 수식을 네메스 점자로 변환합니다.

tools.name: braille_engine_info
tools.description:
Returns the WIA Braille engine version and language coverage counts (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code.).
한국어: 엔진 버전과 지원 언어 규모를 보여줍니다.

tools.name: talk_text_to_gesture_codes
tools.description: Returns WIA Talk ISP codes for the SOUNDS of a text (handshape-location-movement-orientation codes). These are sound-unit codes, NOT a translation into any real sign language such as KSL or ASL. Underlying text-to-IPA is pronunciation-based WIA Braille (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national

tools.name: talk_codes_to_text
tools.description:
Converts WIA Talk ISP codes (e.g. HS02-LC07-MV01-OR03-MM07) back to IPA and WIA Braille. Unknown codes are listed as missing, never invented. Sound-unit codes, not sign language. (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code.)
한국어: ISP 코드를 IPA·점자로 되돌립니다.

tools.name: talk_coverage
tools.description:
Lists which braille/IPA segments currently have a WIA Talk ISP code. Sound-unit codes, not sign language. (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code.)
한국어: ISP 코드가 있는 소리 목록을 보여줍니다.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: braille_verify_brf · Public sink: braille_math_nemeth · Destructive: braille_to_brf.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: braille_verify_brf · Public sink: braille_math_nemeth · Destructive: braille_to_brf

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
